announcements.headline: Accelerating the shift to digital solutions with new special purpose entity from 1 January 2027
announcements.insight: Romande Energie Holding SA establishes a new entity to accelerate digital solutions from January 2027. This follows earlier investments in robotics and grid innovation.

announcements.headline: HEIG-VD and Romande Energie working more closely together to promote innovation and the green transition
announcements.insight: Romande Energie partners with HEIG-VD to support its low-carbon power generation targets. This follows recent investments in robotics and tariff reductions aimed at accelerating the energy transition.

announcements.headline: Romande Energie accelerates progress towards its target of 5 TWh of low-carbon power generation with the construction of a new wind farm in France
announcements.insight: Romande Energie accelerates low-carbon generation via a new French wind farm. This follows its July investment in Hyperion Robotics and August tariff reduction, reinforcing its energy transition commitment.

announcements.headline: Romande Energie's tariffs to fall by 6% with unwavering commitment to the energy transition
announcements.insight: Tariffs fall by 6% while continuing investment in Hyperion Robotics. This aligns with the July commitment to accelerate the energy transition and grid infrastructure.

announcements.headline: Romande Energie investing in Hyperion Robotics to speed up energy transition and grid infrastructure modernisation
announcements.insight: Romande Energie Holding SA is investing in Hyperion Robotics to support energy transition and grid infrastructure modernisation.
